title: feat!: grab only devices listed in devices or enabled_devices (#20)
body:
Auto-discovery with access to every input device (the documented
c 13:* rw cgroup rule) grabbed the host's console keyboard, leaving the
machine without keyboard input until evmqtt was stopped. Auto-discovered
devices are now read without EVIOCGRAB, so their keys still reach the
system; a device named in devices or enabled_devices is grabbed while it
is enabled, as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
